Title: Hybrid Search With RRF
Content: MemorySmith uses two distinct fusion strategies. Memory hybrid search (MemoryApplicationService.RankHybridResults) uses classic Reciprocal Rank Fusion with K=60 and equal weights between lexical and semantic legs. Code search (CodeSearchService.ScoreHybrid) uses a score-based convex combination with configurable HybridVectorWeight (0.75) and HybridLexicalWeight (0.25), saturation normalization on lexical scores, and a ZeroLexicalEvidencePenalty (0.72) for pure-vector results. Both paths are triggered by the /api/memories/search/hybrid endpoint (memory) and memorysmith_code_search tool (code). A planned upgrade path replaces memory RRF with Distribution-Based Score Fusion (DBSF) and adds cross-encoder reranking for code search. See Data/Pages/research/hyperagent-design-rrf-upgrade-fusion.md for the design.
